text: {"rules":[{"id":"ASB-SCREEN-PREGNANT","version":"September 2019","title":"Asymptomatic bacteriuria screening with urine culture in pregnant persons","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for asymptomatic bacteriuria using urine culture in pregnant persons.","grade":"B","effective_date":"September 2019","action":"Screen pregnant adults for asymptomatic bacteriuria using urine culture","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"age\": {\"min\": 18, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"Adults\", \"derived\": {\"min\": \"'Adults' in the topic title taken as age 18 or older; no age number is stated in the text\"}}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant persons\", \"derived\": {\"onset_by\": \"text gives no timing; pregnancy recorded during or before the measurement year chosen as an assumption for review\"}}], \"quote\": \"pregnant persons\"}","numerator":"{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"urine_culture\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"screening for asymptomatic bacteriuria using urine culture\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text states no timing or interval; a urine culture within the measurement year is assumed as a proxy for screening during pregnancy\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'urine_culture' (urine culture lab test) used; no matching concept exists in the vocabulary.","The text gives no timing for screening within pregnancy (e.g., trimester or first prenatal visit) and no repeat interval; the measurement-year window is a declared derived assumption requiring human review. Pregnancies spanning two calendar years may be misclassified.","Adult age threshold (18) derived from the word 'Adults' in the topic title; not stated numerically.","The asterisk after the date ('September 2019 *') refers to an unexplained footnote that is not present in this section and could not be represented.","Follow-up/treatment of positive cultures is not addressed and not represented."]}
